integrity: The proof independently normalizes the six published facet functions by their Euclidean normal lengths, proves a coordinatewise monotonicity reduction of every feasible Chebyshev center to the diagonal, and derives both the exact three-barrier inradius and the complete optimal-center polyhedron. Finite LP replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the full-dimensional six-facet prismatoids in the cited rational-linear-precision family, with positive base parameters in the standard Euclidean realization. It does not determine enclosing spheres or ellipsoids, does not cover arbitrary prismatoids, and degenerations with collapsed facets require removing redundant inequalities before interpreting tangency.
title: Three barriers determine the Euclidean inradius of rational-linear-precision prismatoids
